Package com.csse3200.game.areas

Class LevelGameArea

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.areas.GameArea
com.csse3200.game.areas.LevelGameArea
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Disposable
public class LevelGameArea extends GameArea
A game area built from a tile-based level map file. Loads the map via a MapLoader, renders it through the terrain system, and spawns the player and enemies from the map's spawn data.

Textures for map tiles are loaded from the map's legend; entity textures are loaded from the static lists below. Physical collision from the tile data is handled by the Collision Layer task (#16), which reads LevelMapData.getCollisionLayer().
